detail: According to Wikipedia, awarded for 'showing political courage, enthusiasm and impact with social feeling'.
Listed twice, for 2012 and 2020, in the Folketing's biography.

honor: Commander First Class of the Order of the Dannebrog (Kommandør af 1. grad af Dannebrogordenen)
detail: Announced by Frederiksen in November 2024. She is the first Social Democratic prime minister to accept a royal order: the party had declined them for about a century, a tradition its parliamentary group dropped in early 2024 (DR).

DR reported that she wore the Egyptian Order of the Nile together with the Order of the Dannebrog at the gala dinner of the Egyptian state visit to Denmark on 6 December 2024; the grade was not given.
Listed among her awards in the Folketing's biography (updated September 2026).
